Our small synchronous event bus (`src/EventBus.java`, Java 21, default package, no dependencies) misbehaves when a listener changes the subscriptions while an event is being delivered. Users report that `publish` sometimes throws `ConcurrentModificationException`, and sometimes silently skips a listener, for example when a one-shot listener cancels its own `Subscription` from inside its callback, or when a listener subscribes another listener.

Fix `src/EventBus.java` so that it behaves as README.md specifies, without changing its public API. Read the README's rules on order and on what a listener that is subscribed or cancelled during a delivery receives (the 'Snapshot' rule); they are precise and have examples. `test/TestMain.java` is a plain program (no JUnit) with the README examples and a few more; do not edit it. Build and run it with: rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && javac -d build $(find . -name '*.java') && java -cp build TestMain

More tests than the visible ones, covering the rest of the README, are run when your work is checked.
